title: Wardrobe insights

empty.title: Nothing to analyse yet
empty.message: Add a few pieces to your wardrobe and your insights will appear here.

premiumMessage: Premium shows colors, seasons, brands, most and rarely worn pieces, usage, wardrobe value and cost per wear.
usageTitle: How often you wear your pieces
usageSubtitle: Based on the wears you've recorded since each item was added.
noColors: Add a main color to your items to see your palette.
seasonsHint: Items without a season count for every season.
noWears: Mark outfits as worn to see your favourites here.
rarelyWornHint: Not worn in the last 90 days.
noRarelyWorn: Every piece has been worn recently. Lovely!
valueHint: From the purchase prices you entered, per currency (never converted or added together).
noValue: Add purchase prices to your items to see an estimate.
withoutPrice_one: {{count}} item has no price and isn't included.
withoutPrice_other: {{count}} items have no price and aren't included.
cpwExplain: Cost per wear = purchase price ÷ recorded wears. The more you wear a piece, the lower it gets.
cpwEmpty: Add prices and record wears to see the cost per wear of your pieces.
cpwNotAvailable: Pieces without a price or a recorded wear show “{{label}}” instead of a misleading value.
